newsitem.title: USA: Innovex sees FY97 sales rise equal to '96.
newsitem.headline: Innovex sees FY97 sales rise equal to '96.

text.p: Innovex Inc said Wednesday that it expects its percentage sales increases in fiscal 1997 will parallel those of 1996, based on the disk drive industry's projections of strong demand.
Innovex, which makes precision electrical components for computer elecronics and medical instruments, reported record revenues for fiscal 1996 of $69.6 million, up 39 percent.
Growth in inductive heads is expected to moderate, while growth in magneto resistive (MR) heads used in disk drives is expected to exceed 80 percent, Innovex said.
Since MR heads require twice the conductors of inductive heads, Innovex said it should benefit from the trend toward MR technology. Innovex is the world's largest supplier of conductors, it added.

Earlier, Innovex reported earnings for the fourth quarter of $0.53 a share, after a $0.05 write-off of intangible asets, up from $0.46 a year ago. Revenues for the quarter rose 55 percent to $22.5 million from $14.5 million.

The company said revenue growth reflected continued strength in the computer disk drive market and increased shipments of lead wire assemblies for MR disk drives, including its new Wire Alignment Tab (WAT) product that was introduced late in the third quarter.

"The demand for our WAT product is very strong," Thomas Haley, chairman, said in a statement. "We were shipping over 600,000 WAT units per week at the end of September and expect to be shipping 1,200,000 WAT units per week early next year."
